title: AWS Marketplace Listing Copy Draft — Redwood Inference (v0.9)
body:
OWNER: Soojin Lee (PMM)
LAST EDIT: 2025-02-11
STATUS: Working draft for internal review + AWS submission iteration

NOTE: This doc is intentionally AWS-formatted (headline + highlight bullets + long description + keywords). Security/compliance language must stay within approved patterns (see Messaging Framework + Security FAQ). Any new/stronger claims require Marcus Lin + Olga Petrov sign-off.

============================

============================

Listing hero image

====================================
2) HEADLINE + SHORT DESCRIPTION (AWS)
====================================

Headline (pick one)
1) Predictable LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments
2) High-performance LLM inference with cost and latency controls
3) Developer-first LLM inference optimized for production economics

Short description (1–2 sentences)
Redwood Inference is a developer-first platform for running and optimizing LLM inference across hosted API, dedicated capacity, and private deployments (VPC/on-prem options). Achieve predictable latency and unit costs with production observability, rollouts, and policy-based routing.


============================
3) HIGHLIGHTS (4–6 BULLETS)
============================

Highlights (AWS “Key features” bullets)
- Consistent performance across environments: hosted, dedicated, and private deployments with a unified API and operational model.
- Production-grade reliability: policy-based routing, graceful fallbacks, and rollout controls (canary/A-B) to reduce serving risk.
- Optimize unit economics: batching/caching guidance plus token-level cost and latency breakdowns in the Redwood Console.
- Enterprise-ready governance: security controls and audit logging aligned to enterprise requirements (details available in security documentation).
- Fast activation: marketplace purchase → entitlement activation → link to your Redwood organization in the Console.
- Flexible capacity options: dedicated GPU pools for predictable throughput and data isolation.

Optional “proof points” (use only if we can substantiate in listing context)
- GPU-optimized serving runtime supporting modern attention optimizations and continuous batching.
- Smart routing by policy (latency/cost/region/tier) with automated fallback to compatible model variants when capacity is constrained.


===================================
4) LONG DESCRIPTION (AWS-FRIENDLY)
===================================

Product overview (long description)
Redwood Inference helps engineering teams deploy LLM inference with predictable latency, throughput, and cost—without building and operating the full serving stack.

Start with Redwood’s Hosted API for fast integration and a developer-first onboarding experience. Scale up with Dedicated capacity for predictable performance and data isolation, or deploy Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem options) for regulated workloads and enterprise governance needs.

Redwood combines a high-throughput serving runtime with production operations:
- Policy-based routing by latency, cost, region, and customer tier
- Workload-aware caching and batching controls to reduce per-token cost while meeting latency targets
- Token-level observability for cost and latency breakdowns
- Rollout tooling (canary, A/B testing, and fallback policies) to reduce regression risk

Why buy through AWS Marketplace
AWS Marketplace procurement supports enterprise buying workflows (e.g., committed spend and invoicing through your AWS account) while preserving a developer-first activation path in the Redwood Console.


=============================================
5) “HOW TO GET STARTED” (AWS ACTIVATION STEPS)
=============================================

Activation steps (keep short; link to docs once final)
1) Purchase the desired Redwood Inference plan in AWS Marketplace.
2) In the Redwood Console, link your AWS account to a Redwood organization.
3) Once entitlements activate, generate API credentials and begin sending requests via the Redwood API/SDK.

Troubleshooting note (listing-safe)
Entitlements typically activate shortly after purchase. If activation is delayed or you link the wrong organization, Redwood Support can validate the marketplace event and help resolve the mapping.

[PLACEHOLDER LINK] “AWS Marketplace onboarding + troubleshooting” documentation page (Docs PR: redwood-docs/pr-4821)


============================
6) SKU / PRICING NOTES (DRAFT)
============================

IMPORTANT: AWS listing must be consistent with final SKU taxonomy and invoice descriptors.

SKU packaging (high-level; final names pending PM-873 + ADR)
- Hosted API (usage-based): pay for inference usage (per-token / embeddings where applicable).
- Dedicated (capacity-based): reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput and isolation.
- Private (deployment-based): private deployment options (VPC/on-prem) for regulated workloads.
- Add-ons (where offered as separate SKUs):
  - Compliance / governance add-on (evidence, controls, and documentation package; scope depends on plan)
  - Extended observability retention (longer retention for logs/metrics where applicable)
  - Premium SLA (only where explicitly contracted / SKU’d)

Pricing copy (AWS-safe; avoids hard numbers)
- Pricing varies by plan/SKU and selected options.
- Dedicated/Private deployments may require sizing confirmation during activation (region + capacity requirements).
- If you need a custom configuration (region, capacity, or deployment constraints), contact Redwood Sales.

Discounting / private offers (internal note)
- If buyer requires non-standard terms or deeper discounts than Marketplace allows, route to direct contract decision tree (Jordan Blake + Laura Bennett guidance).


======================================
7) SECURITY + COMPLIANCE COPY (AWS-SAFE)
======================================

Security overview (approved patterns; do not add “fully compliant” claims)
Redwood provides controls for encryption, access management, and audit logging designed for enterprise use. Security and compliance information may vary by deployment mode and customer configuration.

Approved statements (include as 2–4 bullets or a short paragraph)
- Encryption: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest (service-specific details available in the security packet).
- Audit logs: Audit logs are available for key administrative events (scope described in our security documentation).
- Evidence handling: SOC 2 report and additional evidence are available upon request under NDA.
- Shared responsibility: Redwood provides platform controls; customers are responsible for configuration and usage within their cloud environment.

Explicitly avoid (do not include in listing)
- HIPAA/PCI/FedRAMP claims unless Legal + GRC have explicitly approved for this listing.
- “We never store customer data.” (too absolute; logs/telemetry/support artifacts may apply)
- “All data stays in the customer’s VPC.” (only true for certain Private deployments, and must be precisely scoped)

Security CTA (secondary)
Request the latest security packet and evidence (NDA).

============================
9) KEYWORDS (AWS METADATA)
============================

Primary keywords
LLM inference, model serving, GPU inference, low latency, batching, caching, observability, dedicated capacity, private deployment, VPC deployment, on-prem deployment

Secondary keywords
token analytics, cost optimization, routing, fallback, rollouts, canary deployment, enterprise procurement, marketplace billing

Keywords to avoid/limit
zero downtime, guaranteed latency, guaranteed lowest cost, fully compliant


============================
10) FAQ SNIPPETS (OPTIONAL FOR AWS)
============================

Q: How does a Marketplace purchase map to Redwood entitlements?
A: After purchase, link your AWS account to a Redwood organization in the Redwood Console. Entitlements activate for that organization and determine which products/add-ons are enabled.

Q: Can we use AWS Marketplace procurement for Dedicated or Private deployments?
A: Yes. Marketplace SKUs can map to Dedicated/Private entitlements where offered. Redwood will confirm region, capacity, and deployment requirements during activation.

Q: What happens if entitlements don’t activate immediately?
A: Entitlements typically activate shortly after purchase. If activation is delayed, Redwood Support can validate the Marketplace event and help resolve mapping issues.

Q: Do you support audit logs and SSO?
A: Audit logging and SSO/SAML are available depending on plan/package. Request the security packet for current scope and configuration details.
